issues.description: SQL injection vulnerability in searchTodos function - direct string interpolation allows arbitrary SQL execution
issues.suggestion: Use parameterized query: const query = `SELECT * FROM todos WHERE title LIKE $1 OR description LIKE $2`; const searchPattern = `%${keyword}%`; await db.query(query, [searchPattern, searchPattern]);

issues.description: SQL injection vulnerability in searchTodosByStatus - string concatenation with user input allows SQL injection attacks
issues.suggestion: Use parameterized query: const query = 'SELECT * FROM todos WHERE completed = $1'; await db.query(query, [completed]);

issues.description: SQL injection vulnerability in getTodosByUser - template literal interpolation with userId allows unauthorized data access
issues.suggestion: Use parameterized query: const query = `SELECT t.* FROM todos t JOIN user_todos ut ON t.id = ut.todo_id WHERE ut.user_id = $1`; await db.query(query, [userId]);

issues.description: Missing input validation - function accepts null, undefined, or empty strings without validation
issues.suggestion: Add validation: if (!keyword || typeof keyword !== 'string' || keyword.trim().length === 0) { throw new Error('Invalid keyword'); }

issues.description: Incorrect parameter type - completed should be boolean, not string
issues.suggestion: Change function signature to: export async function searchTodosByStatus(completed: boolean): Promise<Todo[]>

issues.description: Missing error handling for database operations - errors will propagate uncaught
issues.suggestion: Wrap db.query in try-catch block and provide meaningful error messages

issues.description: Unsafe type assertion - assumes database always returns correct shape without runtime validation
issues.suggestion: Add runtime type validation before casting to Todo[]

issues.description: LIKE query with leading wildcard prevents index usage - will cause full table scans on large datasets
issues.suggestion: Consider full-text search or remove leading wildcard when possible. For PostgreSQL: use to_tsvector for full-text search

issues.description: Warning comments acknowledging vulnerabilities should not be in production code
issues.suggestion: Remove warning comments and fix the underlying security issues

issues.description: Missing detailed JSDoc documentation for parameters, return values, and error conditions
issues.suggestion: Add complete JSDoc with @param, @returns, @throws, and @example tags

codeQuality.summary: CRITICAL: This PR contains three severe SQL injection vulnerabilities that make it completely unsafe for production. All new functions use string concatenation/interpolation instead of parameterized queries, contradicting the existing secure patterns in the codebase. Additional issues include missing input validation, incorrect type usage, and lack of error handling. Immediate rejection and complete rewrite required.

untestedPaths.reasoning: No tests exist for this function which contains a critical SQL injection vulnerability. Must test security, edge cases, and functional correctness.

untestedPaths.reasoning: Function has SQL injection vulnerability and type mismatch (string vs boolean). Zero test coverage for security or functionality.
untestedPaths.suggestedTest: Test SQL injection: searchTodosByStatus('1 OR 1=1') should not return all records. Test type validation, valid boolean values, null/undefined handling, database errors.

untestedPaths.reasoning: JOIN query with SQL injection vulnerability affecting multi-table data access. No tests for security, data isolation, or correctness.
untestedPaths.suggestedTest: Test SQL injection via userId: getTodosByUser("' OR '1'='1'") should not bypass filtering. Test valid userId returns correct todos, non-existent user returns empty array, JOIN correctness, special characters in userId.

untestedPaths.reasoning: No edge case testing for null, undefined, empty strings, whitespace, or invalid input types across any function.

untestedPaths.reasoning: Special SQL wildcard characters (%, _) in search keywords are untested and could cause unexpected behavior.

untestedPaths.reasoning: No tests verify whether keyword matches work correctly in both title and description fields, or case sensitivity behavior.

untestedPaths.reasoning: JOIN logic between todos and user_todos tables is untested. Could return duplicate todos or incorrect associations.
untestedPaths.suggestedTest: Test user with multiple todos, user with no todos, todo assigned to multiple users (if supported), verify no duplicate results from JOIN.

untestedPaths.reasoning: No error handling tests for database connection failures, query timeouts, or malformed results.
untestedPaths.suggestedTest: Mock db.query to throw connection error, timeout error, return null/malformed data. Verify appropriate error handling and user-friendly messages.

untestedPaths.reasoning: Behavior when no results match search criteria is untested.
untestedPaths.suggestedTest: Test each function with criteria that match zero records. Verify empty array is returned and no errors occur.

untestedPaths.reasoning: International users may search with unicode characters, emoji, or multi-byte characters - untested.
untestedPaths.suggestedTest: Test searchTodos with emoji (📝), Japanese characters (日本語), accented characters (café), right-to-left text. Verify proper handling.

refactorings.summary: Major refactoring required to align with existing secure coding patterns. The three new functions violate established security practices by using string concatenation instead of parameterized queries. Recommended: (1) Fix SQL injection immediately, (2) improve type safety, (3) add validation, (4) extract common patterns, (5) consider consolidating into single flexible search API. All refactorings align code with existing patterns in getTodoById, createTodo, etc.

recommendations.description: BLOCK MERGE - Three critical SQL injection vulnerabilities must be fixed immediately. All functions use string concatenation/interpolation instead of parameterized queries, allowing arbitrary SQL execution and potential data breaches.

BLOCK MERGE - Zero test coverage for security-critical code. Minimum requirement: Add comprehensive security tests for SQL injection prevention, input validation tests, and functional correctness tests before merge consideration.
Fix type safety issue in searchTodosByStatus - parameter should be boolean, not string. Add input validation to all functions following existing validateTodoInput pattern.

Align with existing codebase patterns - use parameterized queries (like getTodoById, createTodo), leverage existing sanitizeInput function, and add error handling consistent with the rest of the module.
Consider consolidating three separate search functions into one flexible searchTodos function with criteria object. This reduces API surface, enables combined searches, and improves maintainability.
Add pagination to search functions to prevent performance issues with large datasets. Consider full-text search instead of LIKE with leading wildcards for better index usage.
Improve JSDoc comments with detailed @param, @returns, @throws, and @example tags. Remove warning comments acknowledging vulnerabilities - fix the issues instead.
